ai_summary: Aditya Birla Fashion and Retail Limited (ABFRL) has filed its quarterly compliance certificate under SEBI Regulation 74(5) for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The company's Registrar and Share Transfer Agent (RTA), MUFG Intime India Private Limited, confirmed that all securities received for dematerialization during the period were processed correctly, accepted/rejected, and recorded in the register of members within the prescribed timelines. This indicates routine regulatory compliance with no material impacts or red flags identified, ensuring proper handling of share transfers from physical to electronic form.
